name: tiny-tools-mcp
description: Small independently deployable Cloudflare Workers MCP tools

scripts.build: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler-home WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.dev:random: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler-home WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler dev --local --config wrangler.random.jsonc --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8788 --inspector-port 9230 --persist-to .wrangler/state/random
scripts.build:random: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler-home WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.random.jsonc --outdir dist/random
scripts.deploy:random: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler-home WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --config wrangler.random.jsonc
scripts.dev:tinytools: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler-home WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler dev --local --config wrangler.tinytools.jsonc --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8789 --inspector-port 9231 --persist-to .wrangler/state/tinytools
scripts.build:tinytools: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler-home WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.tinytools.jsonc --outdir dist/tinytools
scripts.deploy:tinytools: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler-home WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --config wrangler.tinytools.jsonc
